id="comparison-heading">Comparison with Other AI Creative Tools</h2><p>MiniMax Design brings image, video, audio, and text into one workspace. Its AI Agent plans and connects each step, while reusable Skills help you refine, repeat, and scale your workflow.</p></div><div class="tool-page__table-wrap" role="region" aria-labelledby="comparison-heading" tabindex="0"><table aria-labelledby="comparison-heading"><thead><tr><th scope="col">Category</th><th scope="col">Other AI Creative Tools</th><th scope="col" data-highlighted="true">MiniMax Design</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row">Multi-model Support</th><td>Quick prompt-to-video or image-to-video drafts with one model style</td><td data-highlighted="true">All-in-one: image, video, audio, and text.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">AI Agent</th><td>Varies from mostly manual to partially agent-assisted. Many tools still require manual model selection and manual workflow building.</td><td data-highlighted="true">Plans and executes based on your needs</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">Creative Canvas</th><td>Mainly supports displaying and editing assets</td><td data-highlighted="true">Flexible canvas for every content type: View images, video, audio, and text in one place. Use plugins for relighting, storyboards, upscaling, subtitle removal, and more.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">Workflow Automation</th><td>Usually requires manual node linking and prompt writing to organize ideas</td><td data-highlighted="true">The Agent can automatically connect steps and organize your creative process. You can also edit manually, adjust the Agent’s results, or take full control of the creative process yourself.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">Reusable Skills</th><td>Workflows: can only capture and reuse creative task pipelines, but they are often too rigid and lack generality.</td><td data-highlighted="true">Skills: a more flexible way to capture working experience, processes, and methodologies. You can teach the Agent your professional judgment and aesthetic standards so it can consistently reproduce high-quality results at a professional level.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">File &amp; Tool Integration</th><td>/</td><td data-highlighted="true">Works with your local documents and editing software</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></section><section class="tool-page__section" id="faq"><div class="tool-page__container tool-page__faq-container"><div class="tool-page__section-head"><h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2></div><div class="tool-page__faq-list"><details><summary>What is an AI video generator?</summary><p>An AI video generator uses artificial intelligence to turn text prompts, images, scripts, or reference videos into video. MiniMax Design helps you create ads, music videos, social content, animation, cinematic scenes, and more in one workflow.</p></details><details><summary>How does AI video generation work?</summary><p>Start with a prompt, image, script, or reference video. AI interprets your instructions to generate visuals, motion, and scenes. In MiniMax Design, you can refine the result, add audio, edit, and export the finished video in the same workflow.</p></details><details><summary>When should I use image-to-video or reference images?</summary><p>Use image-to-video to animate an existing image while preserving its subject, composition, or first frame. Use reference images to guide a character, product, visual style, or environment across newly generated shots.</p></details><details><summary>How do I write effective AI video prompts?</summary><p>Describe the subject, action, setting, camera movement, visual style, and mood. Keep each prompt focused on one clear shot, and add specific details only when they help control motion, composition, or continuity.</p></details><details><summary>How can I turn a storyboard into AI video prompts?</summary><p>Break the storyboard into individual shots and write one prompt for each. Keep the character, setting, camera direction, and visual style consistent across prompts to help the AI maintain continuity throughout the sequence.</p></details><details><summary>What prompt details help create realistic, cinematic AI videos?</summary><p>Specify the subject, environment, shot size, lens, camera angle, camera movement, lighting, depth of field, and mood. Add realistic motion, materials, and spatial details to make each shot feel more natural and cinematic.</p></details><details><summary>How can I sync AI-generated video clips to background music?</summary><p>Identify the track’s tempo, major beats, and changes in energy. Use faster cuts for high-energy sections and longer shots or smoother transitions for quieter moments, then fine-tune each cut to keep the visuals in rhythm with the music.</p></details><details><summary>Can I edit my AI-generated videos?</summary><p>Yes. Bring your generated clips into the <a class="tool-page__heading-link" href="/tools/video-editor">AI Video Editor</a> in MiniMax Design to trim or reorder shots, add subtitles, and apply effects before exporting your finished video.</p></details></div></div></section></main><footer class="footer"><div class="page-content-frame footer__inner"><div class="footer__main"><div
